description: SUPERSEDED: This initial manually published build had an invalid/stale Morphe source manifest. Do not use it. Use the repository source on main/dev, which now resolves to v1.0.0. Historical release retained for transparency; not the current source artifact.

release_notes:
## Fixes

- Caption font size now spans 8–15 sp, with 13 sp as the default. The slider, saved setting, and localized hints agree.
- Saved diagnostic filenames and export manifests show the release version, 1.3.5. The engine identifier remains `event-rebuild-r2.12`.

## Source and verification

This release is patched from the supplied `1.4.0-local.2.12` MPP. A nearby R2.12 Java source snapshot and the exact assembleable Smali source are included in the repository. The Smali source is authoritative for the released engine; see [source recovery and rebuild notes](https://github.com/YYDarlinker/morphe-ai-caption-translator/blob/v1.3.5/docs/RELEASE-1.3.5.md).

The MPP has the same 72 entries as the supplied bundle. The only changed contents are the version manifest, 14 locale size hints, and the two DEX files. Disassembly shows five intentionally edited extension classes and one patch class; all other classes match. The Java test suite passed 330 tests, and the bundle and metadata validators passed.
